ai.title: CLI model picker applies solo-session discount and shows Free label
ai.summary: The shared `common` package adds `freebucksRowPrice`, which subtracts the `soloDiscount` from a row's quoted price to determine what admission actually charges, returning the reduced price and the list price to strike beside it. The CLI model selector now calls this helper instead of reading the raw quote, so a solo-session discount lowers the displayed multiplier label or shows "Free" when it covers the full cost, and the accent-colour highlight keys off the new `listPrice` return rather than a separate catalog lookup. This aligns the CLI's per-row price display with Desktop and Web, which already draw the solo-discounted price. Tests confirm a 15x row with a 15-point solo discount renders "Free" and a 30x row with the same discount renders "3x" without the old "6x" strike.

In `cli/src/components/freebuff-model-selector.tsx`, the import shifts from `freebucksListPriceFor` to `freebucksRowPrice`, and the `rowDetails` callback uses the new returned `listPrice` to highlight discounted rows and label a fully discounted row as "Free".

entries.title: Shared/Core update: axiom-only-log

ai.title: Axiom allowlist gains silent timeout fields and SDK retry telemetry
ai.summary: The shared Axiom-only log allowlist registers two new boolean fields, receivedModelOutput and repeated, in the STREAM_RECOVERY_FIELDS schema for stream recovery diagnostics. The SDK's silentTimeoutRetry function in the stream implementation now emits a stream_silent_timeout_failed event when a retried request times out or when output had already arrived, distinguishing the cause of the failure. Both the retry and failure events are tagged with the STREAM_RECOVERY_EVENT axiom event so they survive the allowlist filter on hosts that forward only operational events.
ai.evidence: The diff adds `receivedModelOutput` and repeated boolean fields to `STREAM_RECOVERY_FIELDS` in `common/src/util/axiom-only-log.ts`, and modifies `silentTimeoutRetry` in `sdk/src/impl/llm.ts` to emit `stream_silent_timeout_failed` events and tag `stream_silent_timeout_retry` events with `axiomEvent: STREAM_RECOVERY_EVENT`.

changes.what: Added two boolean fields to the Axiom-only log allowlist for stream recovery events.
Enhanced the silent timeout retry logic to emit distinct telemetry events for retries and failures.

ai.summary: The shared tool schemas now normalize common model argument deviations before Zod validation. In `web_search`, the `keepTwoAdditionalQueries` function slices `additional_queries` to the first two items if the array exceeds the limit, preventing rejection of valid searches with slight over-shipment. In `write_file`, the `contentAlias` function maps the keys contents and `_content` to `content` when the primary field is missing, accommodating common naming errors. These repairs are applied via the `repairInput` utility in the `common` package.

You will notice fewer errors when the assistant attempts to save code or search the web, resulting in smoother automated coding sessions.

entries.title: Shared/Core update: utils

ai.title: Expand Windows path lookup keys and tag SDK repair logs with Axiom
ai.summary: The SDK path utilities now offer two Windows-native lookup keys for absolute paths when running on POSIX, covering files both inside and outside the project, and the loose matcher in findFileLookupKey now normalizes multiple separators and letter case. In the SDK LLM stream, the tool-call repair callback now tags its log lines with TOOL_CALL_REPAIR_EVENT and the metric, so the shared Axiom allowlist retains only the repair names and the alias, never the repaired arguments. The shared tool param utility also accepts a JSON stringified array under the replacement or replaces aliases in liftSingleReplacement, matching a shape observed in Flash traces.
ai.evidence: In sdk/src/tools/path-utils.ts, the loose matcher in findFileLookupKey replaces a backslash-only normalizer with a regex that also lowercases keys, and windowsComputerKeys now returns both the relative and full native paths. In sdk/src/impl/llm.ts, two logger.info calls in the repair handler were updated to emit TOOL_CALL_REPAIR_EVENT instead of plain fields.
ai.unknowns: The specific Cloud Desktop scenario that motivates the new outside-project Windows path key is not detailed in the diff.

changes.what: The Windows path lookup now generates both the relative and full native path keys for absolute paths, and the loose file lookup matcher normalizes separators and case.
The LLM stream tool-call repair callback now emits the shared TOOL_CALL_REPAIR_EVENT log marker with a metric and the alias or repair name.
A new TOOL_CALL_REPAIR_EVENT constant and field schema are registered in the Axiom-only log allowlist to retain repair metadata without shipping tool arguments.
The liftSingleReplacement utility now parses a stringified JSON array under the replacement or replaces aliases before treating it as the replacements list.

eli5.text: The assistant can now better understand file locations on Windows computers when it is running in the cloud, allowing it to read both project files and files elsewhere on your system without guessing. It also recognizes a new common typo where a list of edits is sent as a single text block, so it can correct the format before running your command. These updates help the service track its own repairs in internal logs without sharing any of your actual code or file contents, which is a small internal improvement you will not see in your daily use.
